correctness.rationale: All 2^20 vertex masks are evaluated, both programs recover exactly 295 inclusion-maximal independent sets (10 of size 6, 280 of size 7, 5 of size 8). All possible independent supports are compared against every Boolean trace; n>=9 excluded by 2^9>295. Face counts 1,20,160,660,1470,1572,310 and facet counts 10,672,310. Python independently finds the ten pairwise-distance-three tetrahedra; they equal the ten four-facets. Two exact GF(2) boundary eliminations recover ranks 1,19,141,519,941,305 and reduced homology in dimensions 3,4,5 of ranks 10,326,5. Scripts verify actual input and all asserts, and the Euler check 10-326+5=-311 agrees with the face vector. Scope is the explicit finite graph; nothing infinite is inferred.

value.rationale: The twenty-vertex Platonic dodecahedron is a canonical finite incidence structure, and its maximal-independent-set shattering is motivated by the 2024 general MIS-hypergraph VC theory. Its complete exact shattering complex, three distinct facet sizes, geometric ten tetrahedral facets, and three consecutive nonzero homology degrees are mathematically structural and not inferable from ordinary independence counts or scalar VC dimension. Both shattering and algebraic-topological invariants are fully computed, making the claim a natural exact classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
